precepts.text: He measured a thousand cubits and brought me through the waters, and the waters were to the ankles; not only is the gospel going out, your understanding is being measured.
precepts.point: The man with the line went forth eastward and measured, and the waters that ran out on the right side going out from the temple is the gospel going out, the man with the line measuring your understanding of the scriptures.

note.label: Psalm 19: The Perfect Law That Converts the Soul

precepts.why:
Waters ran out on the right side, going out from the temple; that is the gospel going out. Then: “And when the man that had the line in his hand went forth eastward, he measured a thousand cubits, and he brought me through the waters; the waters were to the ankles.”

The man with the line went forth eastward and measured a thousand cubits, and brought Ezekiel through the waters, and the waters were to the ankles. So not only is the gospel going out, your understanding is being measured. The man with the line is measuring your understanding of the scriptures.

precepts.text: In a great house there are vessels of gold, silver, wood, and earth; that house is the house of Israel.
precepts.point: The waters that issue out from under the threshold are the word of the Most High. Just as a tub fills when the water is left running, the word is now being issued out to the four corners of the earth.

note.label: Ezekiel 47: The Waters Issuing from the House

precepts.why:
Ezekiel speaks by similitude and dark sayings, so the house the waters issue from is not a literal building. Paul says, “in a great house there are not only vessels of gold and of silver, but also of wood and of earth; and some to honour, and some to dishonour.”

That great house, with its vessels of gold, silver, wood and earth, is the house of Israel. The house here in Ezekiel is that spiritual house, the house of Israel, and the waters that issue out from under its threshold eastward are the word of the Most High going out.

precepts.text: We as lively stones are built up a spiritual house; this spiritual house represents Israel.
precepts.point: The waters that issue out from under the threshold are the word of the Most High. Just as a tub fills when the water is left running, the word is now being issued out to the four corners of the earth.

note.label: Ezekiel 47: The Waters Issuing from the House

precepts.why:
“Ye also, as lively stones, are built up a spiritual house, an holy priesthood, to offer up spiritual sacrifices, acceptable to God by Jesus Christ.” We, as lively stones, are built up a spiritual house. That spiritual house represents Israel.

So the house whose threshold the waters come from under, whose forefront stands toward the east, is the house of Israel, not a literal building. Ezekiel speaks by similitude and dark sayings, and the waters coming down from under the right side of the house, at the south side of the altar, are the word of the Most High issuing out.

precepts.text: He sanctifies and cleanses it with the washing of water by the word; the water here represents the word.
precepts.point: The waters that issue out from under the threshold are the word of the Most High. Just as a tub fills when the water is left running, the word is now being issued out to the four corners of the earth.

note.label: Ezekiel 47: The Waters Issuing from the House

precepts.why:
The waters are the word. Christ sanctifies and cleanses the church “with the washing of water by the word”. The water here represents the word of the Most High.

So the “waters issued out from under the threshold of the house eastward” are the word issuing out of the spiritual house, the house of Israel. Just as a tub fills when the water is left running, the word is now being issued out to the four corners of the earth.

precepts.text: My doctrine shall drop as the rain; the doctrine of the Most High is the water now distilling to every corner like dew.
precepts.point: The waters that issue out from under the threshold are the word of the Most High. Just as a tub fills when the water is left running, the word is now being issued out to the four corners of the earth.

note.label: Ezekiel 47: The Waters Issuing from the House

precepts.why:
Moses says, “My doctrine shall drop as the rain, my speech shall distil as the dew, as the small rain upon the tender herb, and as the showers upon the grass: Because I will publish the name of the Lord”. The doctrine of the Most High is water: it drops as rain and distils as dew.

That is the water issuing out from under the threshold of the house, the word of the Most High. The doctrine is now distilling to every corner like dew; as a tub fills when the water is left running, the word is being issued out to the four corners of the earth, publishing the name of the Lord.

precepts.text: For I give you good doctrine, forsake ye not my law; the doctrines are the laws.
precepts.point: The waters that issue out from under the threshold are the word of the Most High. Just as a tub fills when the water is left running, the word is now being issued out to the four corners of the earth.

note.label: Ezekiel 47: The Waters Issuing from the House

precepts.why:
“For I give you good doctrine, forsake ye not my law.” The doctrines are the laws. Good doctrine and the law are the same thing in the same breath.

So when Moses says his doctrine shall drop as the rain, and the water issuing from the house is the word, that water is the law of the Most High. The word going out from the spiritual house of Israel to the four corners of the earth is His good doctrine, His law, and we are not to forsake it.

precepts.text: He gave apostles, prophets, evangelists, pastors and teachers, till we all come unto the measure of the stature of the fulness of Christ.
precepts.point: The measuring line measures us up to the stature of Christ, the understanding of the laws and the doctrines.

note.label: Ezekiel 47: The Waters Issuing from the House

precepts.why:
The man with the line measures a thousand cubits and the waters are to the ankles; a thousand more, to the knees; a thousand more, to the loins; then a river that cannot be passed over, “waters to swim in”. The rising water is the word being preached and the understanding increasing as it goes to the four corners of the earth: people coming to understand that Christ is a black man, that we are the Israelites, and that we must keep the commandments.

The measuring line measures us up to the stature of Christ. He “gave some, apostles; and some, prophets; and some, evangelists; and some, pastors and teachers; For the perfecting of the saints, for the work of the ministry, for the edifying of the body of Christ: Till we all come in the unity of the faith, and of the knowledge of the Son of God, unto a perfect man, unto the measure of the stature of the fulness of Christ”. That measure is the understanding of the laws and the doctrines.

It comes in stages, ankles, knees, loins, just as understanding came out over time in the classes: the head covering out of First Corinthians 11, the sabbath, and the new moon being the full moon around 2006 to 2007. As long as we stay in the spirit, more revelation will keep coming, until the water is a river to swim in.

precepts.text: I will send you Elijah the prophet, and he shall turn the heart of the fathers to the children before the great and dreadful day.
precepts.point: Because we now understand who we are and can identify our forefathers in this Bible, it means Elijah has already come and gone.

note.label: Ezekiel 47: The Waters Issuing from the House

precepts.why:
“Son of man, hast thou seen this?” He brings the prophet back to the brink of the river, and there are very many trees on the one side and on the other. Malachi says, “Behold, I will send you Elijah the prophet before the coming of the great and dreadful day of the Lord: And he shall turn the heart of the fathers to the children, and the heart of the children to their fathers, lest I come and smite the earth with a curse.”

Elijah's work is to turn the heart of the children to their fathers. Because we now understand who we are and can identify our forefathers in this Bible, our hearts have been turned to our fathers. That means Elijah has already come and gone, before the great and dreadful day.

precepts.text: Keep my commandments, and live; life comes through keeping the law.
precepts.point: We receive life through the commandments.

note.label: Ezekiel 47: The Waters Issuing from the House

precepts.why:
The waters go toward the east country, down into the desert and into the sea, and the waters are healed: “every thing that liveth, which moveth, whithersoever the rivers shall come, shall live”. Life comes wherever the river comes.

The river is the word, and “Keep my commandments, and live; and my law as the apple of thine eye.” We receive life through the commandments. Life comes through keeping the law, so wherever the word of the Most High reaches and is kept, every thing shall live.

precepts.text: Follow me, and I will make you fishers of men; the fishers point to the same last-day gathering of Israel.
precepts.point: The fishers stand upon it from Engedi to Eneglaim, and the fish are according to their kinds, exceeding many. This is Israel in the last days coming alive again and growing into an exceeding great army.

note.label: Ezekiel 47: The Waters Issuing from the House

precepts.why:
“the fishers shall stand upon it from En–gedi even unto En–eglaim”, a place to spread forth nets, and “their fish shall be according to their kinds, as the fish of the great sea, exceeding many.” Christ said to His disciples, “Follow me, and I will make you fishers of men.”

The fishers are fishers of men, and the fish exceeding many, according to their kinds, are Israel in the last days coming alive again and growing into an exceeding great army. The fishers on the river of the word point to that same last-day gathering of Israel.

precepts.text: Bring forth fruits meet for repentance, for the axe is laid to the root of every tree that does not.
precepts.point: The tree represents Israel, and once the word spreads we know how to bring forth fruit.

note.label: Ezekiel 47: The Waters Issuing from the House

precepts.why:
By the river grow “all trees for meat, whose leaf shall not fade, neither shall the fruit thereof be consumed”, bringing forth new fruit according to their months, “because their waters they issued out of the sanctuary”. The tree represents Israel, and its fruit comes from the water, the word.

“Bring forth therefore fruits meet for repentance”. The axe is laid to the root of every tree that does not. Once the word spreads, we know how to bring forth fruit: fruits meet for repentance, new fruit every month, leaf that does not fade, because our waters issued out of the sanctuary.

precepts.text: Thou shouldest not have looked on the day of thy brother in the day that he became a stranger; a stranger is one living out of his own land among his tribesmen.
precepts.point: The stranger here is not another nation. A stranger is an Israelite living out of his own tribe's land; if you are of Judah and you sojourn in Benjamin, you are counted a stranger. Christianity uses this verse to claim the other nations dwell among Israel and receive the land, but that is not what is being said.

note.label: Ezekiel 47: The Waters Issuing from the House

precepts.why:
“the strangers that sojourn among you” who get inheritance among the tribes of Israel are not another nation. Obadiah shows what a stranger is: “thou shouldest not have looked on the day of thy brother in the day that he became a stranger; neither shouldest thou have rejoiced over the children of Judah in the day of their destruction”.

Judah became a stranger in the day of their destruction, when they were put out of their own land. A stranger is one living out of his own land, an Israelite out of his own tribe's land among his tribesmen. If you are of Judah and you sojourn in Benjamin, you are counted a stranger, and “in what tribe the stranger sojourneth, there shall ye give him his inheritance”.

Christianity uses this verse to claim the other nations dwell among Israel and receive the land, but that is not what is being said. The stranger is thy brother.

precepts.text: Israel dwelt as strangers away from their own land, showing what a stranger is.
precepts.point: The stranger here is not another nation. A stranger is an Israelite living out of his own tribe's land; if you are of Judah and you sojourn in Benjamin, you are counted a stranger. Christianity uses this verse to claim the other nations dwell among Israel and receive the land, but that is not what is being said.

note.label: Ezekiel 47: The Waters Issuing from the House

precepts.why:
“And these are they of Jewry that came up from the captivity, where they dwelt as strangers, whom Nabuchodonosor the king of Babylon had carried away unto Babylon.” Israel dwelt as strangers in Babylon, away from their own land. That is what a stranger is: an Israelite living out of his own land.

So the stranger that sojourns among you and begets children, counted “as born in the country among the children of Israel” and given inheritance in the tribe where he sojourns, is an Israelite out of his own tribe's land. Of Judah, sojourning in Benjamin, you are the stranger. It is not another nation receiving the land, whatever Christianity claims from this verse.

note.label: Radicalize The Youth

precepts.why:
“But let judgment run down as waters, and righteousness as a mighty stream.” It keeps growing. Imagine somebody in this room saying Christmas is okay or we can smoke weed. The whole room would react like a scratch on a chalkboard. Wisdom is prevalent. God has used others, but IUIC is in the vanguard pushing these laws, and that's fact, not feeling.

Other camps laughed years ago at our fringes, wearing them only on camp garments. Influence grew until their own people asked about Numbers saying garments, and they had to submit. I came from that generation and know those leaders; most city camps came out of the same school, doing the same things. But the waters rose. The Most High is moving young men and women to change things and stand stiffly in his laws without shame.

note.label: Radicalize The Youth

precepts.why: “a paradise, whose fruit endureth for ever, wherein is security and medicine”. Same medicine as the leaves. “them that are cured with his word”. God's word is the medicine that cures you.

note.label: Radicalize The Youth

precepts.why: “And makest men as the fishes of the sea”. Men are the fishes. As the word rises, those men learn through you; share this word, this water, throughout the whole earth.

note.label: Radicalize The Youth

points: “he brought me through the waters; the waters were to the ankles.” Through God's word. This is the progression of the truth and how it grew. When I came in, we shopped on the Sabbath, went from camp to the store, and women wore pants except on the Sabbath. The doctrine was rob them that robbed you. Prayers were curse the black woman, curse Oprah. There were multiple wives and dealing with heathen women. Then wisdom rose beyond the ankles and we learned we couldn't do that.

note.label: Radicalize The Youth

points: “the waters were to the knees.” Understanding changed: no Sabbath shopping, cursing our people in prayers, or robbing. Some stayed at the ankles. If wisdom is a pure influence, you'll change your mind and grow. “the waters were to the loins.” The Most High grew our understanding and our application of the law. Keeping the commandments is the key to growth. People ask our recipe: we stand on the commandments and faith of Jesus Christ. You can't have one without the other. Keep the commandments.

note.label: Radicalize The Youth

points: “it was a river that I could not pass over”. “waters to swim in, a river that could not be passed over.” The water rises until you can't get around it. That's happening now. We're everywhere, the word is everywhere. You can explain who you are from Deuteronomy 28, captivity and prophecy. You won't be tripped up by God so loved the world in John 3:16. Sisters can explain it too; that means God is dealing with you and you're anointed. Mark 7 isn't permission for pork; it's unwashed hands. First Timothy 4 doesn't mean you can eat everything. You can't get past this understanding.

note.label: Radicalize The Youth

points: “at the bank of the river were very many trees on the one side and on the other.” That's what we read in Revelation 22 about the tree and its leaves.

note.label: Radicalize The Youth

points: “because their waters they issued out of the sanctuary”. God's word, the laws. “and the fruit thereof shall be for meat, and the leaf thereof for medicine.” That word is the medicine that cures you.

note.label: Radicalize The Youth

points: “go down into the desert, and go into the sea”. The word goes through America, Africa, Asia Minor, Europe, Saudi Arabia, down to Australia, all around the world. You can't get around us, block us out, or pretend we're not there. His sheep hear his voice. It takes radical minds to push this forward. We here in America have to set the world back in order under God's laws. The scepter won't depart from Judah or the lawgiver from between his feet. Judah is here.
